=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:516-542, 604-627 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runner wait is credited twice. The new first-block credit (line 535) raises REPORT_MAX_AGE to base + elapsed. The existing identity_stale retry (line 619) then subtracts only the queue wait and adds the arrival wait, so the limit becomes about base + 2E - queue.
  WHY: A report that was already stale on arrival can be rejected by the first verify and accepted by the retry, which widens the OIDC iat replay bound. The new tests do not catch it because the retry's own-run read is not stubbed. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:401-415 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new head_unpushed hold in single_pass_gate runs before single_pass_extensions and the clean-outcome return. It fires for any checkout that descends from the PR head, even with no extension marker.
  WHY: This reverses the #9011/#9134 behavior, where an unpushed [ai-merge-resolve] commit with no marker must not hold the gate. It costs an extra review and audit cycle. test_unpushed_local_commit_without_extensions_does_not_hold (tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:673-682) passes only because the fake git reports no ancestry. Confidence is 3 from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and 4 from the others; the maximum is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:606-619 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS in the identity_stale retry has no upper bound, while the new first-block credit is clamped to 86400. This was raised as a hardening suggestion; no severity was stated.
  WHY: A far-back or skewed run_started_at can inflate the retry limit without bound. The suggested fix is one line: clamp to 86400 after line 613.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:516-542, 604-627 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait credit is applied twice. The retry at line 619 subtracts only the queue wait and adds the arrival wait. The effective limit is about base + 2E - queue, and the retry credit is not capped at 86400.
  WHY: A stale-on-arrival identity report is accepted by the retry, which widens the iat replay bound. The new tests miss it because the /actions/runs/777 read is not stubbed.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:408-415 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The head_unpushed hold applies to every descendant checkout, runs before the clean check, and ignores whether an extension marker exists.
  WHY: This reverses the #9011/#9134 no-marker behavior. test_unpushed_local_commit_without_extensions_does_not_hold passes only because the fake git returns 1 when FAKE_GIT_ANCESTORS is empty.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:612-613 | confidence=3 (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3)
  PROBLEM: The retry credit has no upper bound, unlike the first-block credit, which is clamped to 86400.
  WHY: Suggested fix: add `[ "${INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS}" -le 86400 ] || INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS=86400` after line 613.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:535-538, 619-623 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner wait may be credited twice, which leads to overly permissive age limits.
  WHY: The identity_stale retry block performs an independent calculation, so reports that should be rejected as identity_stale may be accepted.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:403-412 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new head_unpushed gate hold is overly broad.
  WHY: It holds any checkout HEAD that descends from the PR head. This reverses the earlier no-hold behavior for an unpushed local commit without extension markers, and causes unnecessary audit cycles.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:390, 516-542, 604-627 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner wait is credited twice from the same clock. Line 535 sets base + elapsed, and the retry at line 619 computes REPORT_MAX_AGE - queue + arrival_waited, giving a limit of base + 2*elapsed - queue.
  WHY: An identity up to about 4h old at dispatch is accepted, which widens the OIDC iat freshness bound. The tests (tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:6209-6218, 2378-2393) never exercise the retry's own-run read.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:401-415 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new head_unpushed hold runs before single_pass_extensions and fires with no extension marker. The #9011 invariant at lines 220-223 limits the checkout-head comparison to the marker-present case.
  WHY: The judge's approved merge is skipped (security_hold_head_unpushed) and an extra review and audit cycle is spent. tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:673-682 passes vacuously because the fake git (lines 101-104) reports no ancestry.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:612-614 (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3)
  PROBLEM: The retry credit is not clamped, while the new credit is capped at 86400 (line 527).
  WHY: Suggested fix: add `[ "${INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS}" -le 86400 ] || INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS=86400` after line 613.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:535, 604–621 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The intake can credit the same runner wait twice. The retry adds the elapsed time again and subtracts only the queue wait.
  WHY: With a 3600 s base limit, no queue wait, a 60 s runner wait and a token 3650 s old at arrival, the first verify rejects at 3660 s and the retry accepts at 3720 s. This widens the identity replay window.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:390, 535, 619 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner wait is credited twice. The final limit is base + 2E - 2Q, roughly double the documented single credit.
  WHY: A report that was already stale on arrival should stay rejected per README.md:2504-2518. The OIDC iat replay bound is widened, and the tests miss it because only the /attempts/ endpoint is stubbed.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:408-415 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new unconditional head_unpushed hold runs before single_pass_extensions and before the clean-marker path at line 428. It includes the documented #9011/#9134 shape.
  WHY: Every #9011-shaped run now takes hold=true reason=head_unpushed, which costs an extra cycle. tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:673-682 passes vacuously because of the fake ancestry default at line 104.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:606-619 (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2)
  PROBLEM: INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS is clamped only to ≥ 0, with no upper bound, while the block-1 credit is clamped to 86400 (line 527).
  WHY: Suggested fix: clamp with `[ "${INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS}" -le 86400 ] || INTAKE_ARRIVAL_WAITED_SECONDS=86400`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
